name: Crossville (United States)
description: A white cross dividing the field into blue and red quarters, charged at the hoist with an X of red and blue arrowheads and bearing the name CROSSVILLE in blue on the fly.
history: Crossville is a city in and the county seat of Cumberland County, Tennessee. The flag was adopted on 10 December 2019 (the winning design of a city contest, adopted on 10 December 2019, according to Flags of the World citing the assistant city clerk).

features.role: X of red and blue arrowheads at the crossing
